# P1.01 — Design system and IDE shell

Spec: `docs/tickets/29_P1.01__design-system-and-ide-shell.md` · run ledger: `docs/build/runs/P1.01.md` · ADR-012
**Stage A only** — all code + deterministic tests. Stage B (deploy `dev` + bounded live verify) is operator-gated → **D-P1.01-1**; $0 inference either way.

## Summary

The beta's flat shell is replaced **on the `/p/:project…` routes** by the §5.1 seven-region IDE layout,
with the complete §5.9 design system underneath it — one token table driving public pages, the retained
flat workspace shell, and the IDE alike (REQ-GROWTH-2's token half). The host stays the landed Hono SSR +
esbuild-islands stack (ADR-007); the IDE mounts as a second, attribute-driven island — recorded in
**ADR-012**, no React Router framework-mode rewrite.

## What landed

**`@rhema/tokens`** — the full §5.9 set: `DARK_VARS`/`LIGHT_VARS` (no pure black/white anywhere),
`paperVars` + `[data-paper="light"|"dark"|"follow"]` pinning inside either shell theme, the 4-pt spacing
scale, radius 4/8/12, `TYPOGRAPHY` (Literata 17/1.55 serif + Inter 16/1.55 sans presets, heading em
ladder, tabular-figure shell sizes 13/14/12, JetBrains Mono 13, reader stepper ±2 px ×3, print
11 pt/1.4/6.5 in), `MOTION` (stream 120 ms/caret pulse, phase 160 ms, finding 200 ms, pane 160 ms),
`contrast.ts` (WCAG luminance), `themeCss()` (full stylesheet: `@font-face`, `[data-theme]`/`[data-paper]`
/`[data-font]` blocks, `.paper` scope remap, 2-px accent `:focus-visible`, `prefers-reduced-motion`
collapse, print rules) and `ideCss()` (the pane stylesheet generated from the same `LAYOUT` constants the
pure function uses). **28 token/contrast unit tests** compute the contrast invariants — shell body ≥7:1,
paper body ≥10:1, chips ≥4.5:1, meaningful non-text marks ≥3:1 — rather than eyeballing them.

**`@rhema/ide`** (new, framework-free, DOM-free): `paneLayout(width, state)` — the §5.1 yield order as a
pure function at the 1600/1280/1024/~768 px breakpoints; `paneDrag` — the Page 45–80 ch clamp where a
violating drag collapses the adjacent pane instead; `paneStorageKey` + `serializePaneState`/
`parsePaneState` (per-user×project `localStorage`, **never the URL**); theme parse/resolve/cycle +
`themeBootScript()` (the synchronous pre-paint IIFE); `CONTROL_DISCLOSURE` — the §5.1 advanced set
verbatim (view.source, raw.tokens, model.tier, model.names, memory.files, restore.old, feed.verbose);
`viewMenuModel` (Write·Read·Focus + the two toggles; Source absent). **26 tests.**

**`@rhema/ui`** — `IdeShell`: the seven regions as SSR landmarks (`<nav>` Rail, `<aside>` Files strip,
`<main>` Page on the `.paper` sheet, `<aside role="complementary">` Margin ticks+cards, `<aside>`
Timeline, `<section role="tablist">` Desk chat/feed/findings/claims, `<footer>` Status bar); the View +
Theme menus; the phone-width fallback bar. `ide-states.tsx`: the §5.9 catalogue — EmptyProject,
EmptyFindings, ShellSkeleton (never a spinner on the paper), StreamingBlock, SyncPill, RunFailed,
ConflictBanner (never a modal), OfflineQueued, InsufficientBalanceSwap (button swap + `role="alert"`),
FrozenBanner, and `CancelRunModal` — the product's ONE blocking modal. **6 tests** assert the regions,
the menu contents (Source absent), every `data-ide-state`, and the no-modal/no-spinner rule.

**Persistence + theme plumbing** — `@rhema/db` migration `0027_theme_prefs.sql` (`"user".app_theme`
dark/light/auto, default dark; `projects.paper_theme` already existed from 0002); `apps/api`
`theme-routes.ts` (`GET|PUT /settings/theme`, `PUT /projects/:id/paper-theme`, tenant-scoped through
txRunner — **4 PGlite tests**); `@rhema/api-client` typed methods + `ProjectRow.paperTheme`;
`apps/api/src/project-list.ts` selects it.

**`apps/web`** — `render.tsx` stamps `data-theme` (resolved) + `data-app-theme` (stored pref) +
`data-paper` + `data-project` on `<html>` and inlines the boot script in `<head>` so the theme resolves
**before first paint** (no wrong-theme flash; `auto` re-resolves against `matchMedia` and subscribes to
OS changes). `server.ts`: the `ideContext` helper feeds every `/p/:project…` render (project, dossier,
revisions, editor, run sheet, import, export — including error re-renders); `?focus=1` is honored
everywhere; `POST /ide/theme` + `POST /p/:project/paper-theme` forward to the api same-origin (the bundle
never holds a credential); `POST /settings/theme` is the no-JS form counterpart (the Settings page gains
an Appearance select); `/assets/ide.js` + `/assets/fonts/:file` serve the built artifacts.
`build-client.mjs` builds `src/client/ide.ts` → `public/ide.js` (the second island — attribute-driven
enhancement, not `hydrateRoot`, so no hydration-mismatch class exists) and copies the four self-hosted
OFL-1.1 variable woff2 fonts (exceptions recorded in `licenses.exceptions.json`). The island wires pane
toggles `⌘1`/`⌘2`/`⌘J`, drag handles with live preview + clamp-on-commit, Focus `⌘⇧F`, Advanced `⌘⇧M`,
paper cycle `⌘⇧L`, the menus, the font preset + reader stepper — all persisted to the per-user×project
key, `?focus=1` applied then stripped from the address bar. **11 new web tests** cover the SSR stamping,
both POST routes, the Settings form, and the flat pages staying flat.

## Gates

```text
pnpm turbo build lint typecheck   → 114/114 tasks
pnpm test                         → 2227 pass / 0 fail (281 files)
pnpm check:licenses               → OK — 505 packages (3 OFL-1.1 font exceptions recorded)
pnpm check:protocol-markers       → OK — 39 public-facing files scanned
check-build-memory.sh .           → clean
```

Vocabulary lint clean: the pane is **Files**, the drawer is **Desk**, views are **Write · Read · Focus**;
`Advanced` appears exactly once (the View menu reuses `COPY.runSheet.advanced` — the single sanctioned
disclosure label).

## Deferrals

- **D-P1.01-1** (OPEN): Stage B — `pulumi preview`/`up` on `dev` (image bump only expected), headless
  assert of the pane document + `/assets/ide.js` + fonts, operator click-through.
- **D-P1.01-2** (OPEN): the spec-scheme deep links (`/p/:project/v/:n`, `/r/:run`, `/f/:findingId`,
  `/a/:artifactId`, `/chat`) never existed in the beta — they land with their owning surfaces
  (P1.02/P1.05/P1.07/…); the restore mechanism (stored arrangement, `?focus=1`, `#finding-<id>` anchors)
  is already shipped and tested.

## Notes for reviewers

- Host ruling: **ADR-012** — the IDE mounts as an attribute-driven island on the Hono SSR host; no
  React tree is hydrated, so SSR markup must stay correct at every viewport before script (it is —
  `ide-css.ts` breakpoints mirror `LAYOUT` constants).
- No landed route was removed or 404'd; workspace/public pages keep the flat `Shell` on the same token
  set.
- Merge policy: **OPERATOR** — do not merge; Stage B is operator-gated.
